title: Listening Drill — Drawing a floor plan — Trial review
description: Conversation about a trial. One synthetic recording, six questions. Recommended time: 7 minutes.

sections.title: Drawing a floor plan — Trial review
sections.transcript:
HOST: You ran two introductory sessions on drawing a floor plan last week. What happened in the first one?

GUEST: On the first run, several people reported a problem with skewed lines. At first we wondered whether it was a problem with the instructions. A closer inspection revealed the fault: damaged tape.

HOST: What changed when you ran the session again?

GUEST: On each trial, we now keep a record of wall length so changes can be compared. For the second trial we let everyone borrow tape measure instead of bringing their own. That helped us keep the equipment as consistent as possible.

HOST: What should people who attended do now?

GUEST: Send any suggestions directly to the design mentor before the next group arrives. The next group comes on Sunday, so we have time to compare notes beforehand.
